title: An agent's commit names the agent's own model in its Co-Authored-By trailer, and a check refuses one that names another
why:
Lane notes-fix-large-1 ([ended:lane:-notes-fix-large-1]) told Haiku test-authors to sign commits as Opus 5.5; one did (3b5516cf8 on pwsh-followups). A trailer that names the wrong model misstates who wrote the code (lane, 05:47 CST Nov 8). || 05:50 CST Nov 15: sighting (relayed by coordinator from the #3498 lane, ci-job-runs-local-actions): the lane's test-author commits carry a Co-Authored-By Haiku trailer. Triage read no commit and cannot say whether it matches the author's model.

[00:16 CST Nov 16, triage] Full note before the trim to 200 words (goal item 6, option b):
Fix: the brief template's trailer line names the spawn's model; a check refuses an agent commit whose Co-Authored-By model differs from the spawn's model; red case first, from 3b5516cf8. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Filed 05:50 CST Nov 8; the coordinator assigns a lane. Doing in lane [ended:lane-commit-trailer-model] (coordinator, 06:16 CST Nov 8; owner item 410 a lets a gap fix start a lane). Coordinator (13:03 CST Nov 9), from lane review-record-provenance (#2440, [ended:Lane:-review-record-provenance]): folded candidate trailer-names-run-model. Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane (was [ended:lane-commit-trailer-model]). Lane code-agents started 07:29 CST Nov 12 (coordinator fan-out, Sonnet, medium). Sighting 15:52 CST Nov 12 (lane page-settle-signals, PR #2986): commits 254acbe45 and 543133cc4 carry "Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5" but a Haiku 5.5 test-author wrote them; no history rewrite (coordinator). Sighting 01:55 CST Nov 14 (lane fan-code-workflows via the coordinator 01:54, relayed; unchecked by triage): the docs commits on #2875 carry a Haiku 5.5 co-author trailer, the record-writer's own model, where Sonnet 5.5 was expected. This step's rule is that a trailer names the agent's own model, so the trailer is right if the record-writer ran on Haiku. Open: whether the record-writer should have run on Sonnet per the model table (agent-model-cap, unread by triage), which would be a spawn-model gap, not a trailer gap. Sighting 04:07 CST Nov 15 (lane tests-never-read-live-origin-main, PR #3494, via the coordinator 04:07, relayed; unchecked by triage): the commit on 17c64a217537 reads `Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5` while the lane's session read claude-sonnet-5-5 (get_session last_served_model). A wording slip in the trailer, not model drift. The coordinator named a candidate guard (the trailer's model matches the session's) and left it to triage: this step already holds that check, so no new step.
